name: 19348 · Kennett Sq, PA
findings: ZIP 19348 (Kennett Sq) has 129 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19348 (Kennett Sq) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19348 (Kennett Sq) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
